qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Historical ROIC of 5-8% falls well short of the 12% hurdle. Massive post-Shaw debt load (>CAD 44B) and ongoing 4-carrier wireless price pressure prevent pricing power above inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (historical ROIC 5-8% vs 12% hurdle; heavy Shaw debt and competitive wireless discounting undermine pricing power).
qualitative.evidence: Rogers' 5-year median ROIC is ~6-7% (2020: 7.9%, 2021: 7.1%, 2022: 5.5%, 2023: 6.6%, 2024: 7.3%), consistently below the 12% hurdle. The $26B Shaw acquisition elevated net debt above CAD 44B (leverage peaked at >5x EBITDA), while competitive pricing pressures from Quebecor/Freedom Mobile and CRTC regulatory access mandates restrict organic ARPU growth below inflation.
